body:
Found by the ouroboros#284 triage of the stdlib/corpus AOT gate tiers at the `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` pin. Affected rows (12): `test_buffer_store_type.eigs`, `test_coverage_v2.eigs`, `test_dict_write_keys.eigs`, `test_line_after_return.eigs`, `test_meta_fstr_host_str.eigs`, `test_meta_host_builtins.eigs`, `test_meta_parity.eigs`, `test_meta_reserved_dunder.eigs`, `test_meta_string_escapes.eigs`, `test_not_precedence.eigs`, `test_stdlib_fixes.eigs`, `test_ui.eigs`. Ledgered as `class:binding-order` until fixed.

**Minimal repro.** `test_buffer_store_type.eigs`: retain the C globals cannot preserve runtime-dependent outward/top-level binding order. VM/AOT observation: `AOT: function 'store_fails' assigns module name 'b' whose first module-level binding does not provably precede the function's first use. The VM's outward-write rule is checked at RUNTIME (a missing outer binding makes the write a function-local that dies with the call); this order cannot be answered statically, so it is refused (see the outward-write arm).`. The clean control removes that construct or uses the supported alternative named by the refusal.

**Affected rows:** `test_buffer_store_type.eigs`, `test_coverage_v2.eigs`, `test_dict_write_keys.eigs`, `test_line_after_return.eigs`, `test_meta_fstr_host_str.eigs`, `test_meta_host_builtins.eigs`, `test_meta_parity.eigs`, `test_meta_reserved_dunder.eigs`, `test_meta_string_escapes.eigs`, `test_not_precedence.eigs`, `test_stdlib_fixes.eigs`, `test_ui.eigs`.

## Done when

All affected rows compile and run byte-identically to the pinned VM (including exit status), and the `class:binding-order` ledger rows are removed.

— Claude (orchestrator, Claude Code)
title: AOT: C globals cannot preserve runtime-dependent outward/top-level binding order
